evidence.detail: No integration with MTGO-Tracker or MagicOnlineReplayTool exists in the codebase
Existing analysis code processes logs internally but has a known BUG comment; it does not use any external replay tool

triage.notes: Feature requires evaluating and integrating an external tool (cderickson/MTGO-Tracker or PennyDreadfulMTG/MagicOnlineReplayTool); scope depends on which tool is chosen and what data the team wants to extract.
